job.job_description:
AI/Agent Engineer

Core Skills:

58 years of overall experience, with 3+ years in AI/ML/LLM-based solutions and Hands on experience building agentic systems., Agentic Frameworks & Cloud API, LLM & RAG

Integration, AI agent frameworks, Prompt engineering, tool integration, agent

orchestration, Python.




Preferred / Good to have Skills:

Python automation; CI/CD

Hospitality/integration domain exposure




Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered agents using Large Language Models (LLMs)

and agent orchestration frameworks.

Build and integrate agent capabilities such as tool usage, prompt engineering, skill

development, memory management, and workflow orchestration to automate business

processes.

Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, APIs, and knowledge sources while

ensuring scalability, security, and reliability.

Evaluate and optimize agent performance through prompt tuning, testing, monitoring,

and continuous improvement.

Collaborate with architects, data engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver

production-ready AI solutions aligned with enterprise standards.

Good understanding of Python




Location: Preferred Bangalore or all ITCI locations(Pune, Kolkata, Gurgaon, Hyderabad)
